posts.author: MrRyanBirth
posts.body:
First of all, I'm new to RPG Maker
I'm using the MZ version and already testing stuff.
I wanted to know if there is a way to not make the same debuffs stack.
Ex, enemy debuffs my attack and not be able to do it again
Also, how much does a debuff lower? 25%, 50%?
One more time, I'm really new to RPG Maker, sorry if anyone already asked this (didn't find anything), and thank you!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
that is the difference between buffs and states.
states are independent and do not stack.
buffs and debuffs can stack and remove each other up to a stack = +2 or -2.
As for the value I can't tell you but it should be listed in the help file of the editor.
I never use buffs and debuffs at all, because with states you can do similiar and have better control

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
MrRyanBirth said:
Also, how much does a debuff lower? 25%, 50%?
Click to expand...
each level of a buff/debuff alters the parameter by +/- 25% of its base value
